headline: CHAMPIONSHIP STAKES HIGH

artDirection.backgroundPrompt:
A stylized Counter-Strike tactical operative in full combat gear captured in an intense aiming stance, gripping a sleek AK-47 rifle with precision. The character is rendered in bold solid colors with dramatic cast shadows - no gradients or soft shading. Dynamic low-angle perspective looking up at the operative, creating a heroic larger-than-life competitive gaming feel. The figure wears tactical vest in deep navy (#2D0F42) with orange accent straps (#FF6B2F), combat helmet with visor, and fingerless gloves. Bold graphic illustration style with clean crisp edges suitable for compositing - think flat vector meets editorial esports illustration. The operative is positioned center-right of the canvas, rifle barrel extending toward upper left, leaving the left side open for text overlay. Energy lines and small geometric fragments radiate from the weapon's muzzle flash area. Dramatic lighting creates sharp contrasts between highlights and shadows. The character's pose suggests precision, focus, and championship-level intensity. Color palette emphasizes the template's purple tones with strategic orange highlights for visual pop. NO text, NO logos, NO background - only the tactical operative and weapon rendered in the bold, stylized CB illustration aesthetic with sharp vector edges and premium competitive gaming energy.

From vault-illustrations-illustration-01: Borrow the bold vector illustration style with clean lines, dramatic shadow casting, and energetic athletic pose - apply this same dynamic energy to the Counter-Strike operative. From vault-illustrations-illustration-03: Use the bold graphic vector art style with simplified forms, clean geometric shapes, and strong color blocking against contrasting background - perfect for the tactical character design. From vault-illustrations-illustration-06: Apply the flat design vector approach with clean geometric shapes, minimal shading with simple drop shadow, and contemporary sports graphic style for consistent brand aesthetic. From vault-previous-posts-slide-3-twitter-new: Reference the flat illustration style with clean lines, dramatic angular elements, and modern esports aesthetic - use similar character proportions and competitive gaming energy for the Counter-Strike operative.
